info.title: sys-brightness-shortcut
info.author: piegottin
info.details:
Adjust screen brightness from anywhere with L + R + Up/Down (hold to repeat), in 10% steps.

- Steam Deck-style on-screen bar in the top-left corner (sun icon, animated fill, percentage), shown over games and the HOME menu. It fades out 1.5 s after the last change.
- Soft feedback tick whose pitch follows the brightness level.
- The new brightness is saved like the system setting.

Requires Atmosphère. Reboot after installing or enabling it: the bar only works when the sysmodule starts together with the console.

Log: sdmc:/atmosphere/logs/brightness_shortcut.log

AI use: AI-generated, not reviewed line by line. AI also used for: icon/banner art, description text.

changelog: v1.1.1: marks the sysmodule as requiring a reboot, MIT license. v1.1.0: on-screen brightness bar, new feedback sound, fixes Exosphere panic on fatal errors.
